name: raylfit
expr: [s_b, sc_b] = raylfit(x); [s_a, sc_a] = raylfit(x, 0.01); [s_one, sc_one] = raylfit(xone); [s_e, sc_e] = raylfit([]);
comment: Sig: [shat, sci] = raylfit(x[, alpha]). Rayleigh MLE: σ = √(Σx²/(2N)); CI from chi² inversion 2N·σ̂² ~ σ²·χ²(2N). Edges: non-default α; single-element x; empty input -> NaN.
